640-1981-2415-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1661-5078-7295-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Driver of the Dead

624-2777-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1745-7841-8089.description:
Activate Lord of the Forsaken by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a +1/+1 counter on it and not copying a Human

628-4050-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a non-Human creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a -1/-1 counter on it.
628-4050-7936.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a non-Human you control with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then also enter with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

997-6012--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
997-6012--5--195.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reluctant Role Model trigger.
Resolve Reluctant Role Model's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1349-5231-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
1349-5231-6854.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Host of the Hereafter's ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Host of the Hereafter, adding {R}.
When Host of the Hereafter dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Host of the Hereafter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

390-670-1619-3455.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
390-670-1619-3455.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vizier of Many Faces and Hulking Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
390-670-1619-3455.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1090-2146-3375-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

141-2921-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-2921-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Lively Dirge.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1874-3490-5231-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-3490-5231-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

6913-7009-7309.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
6913-7009-7309.description:
Activate Chameleon using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Don & Leo triggers, blinking Chameleon. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

2511-5687-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2511-5687-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Skittering Precursor and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
2511-5687-7084.notes: You can instead sacrifice the creature tokens to their own abilities instead of sacrificing them to Bloodflow Connoisseur.

1414-2034-2866-4986.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1496-3054-3416-5670.easyPrerequisites: You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
1496-3054-3416-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers twice, causing you to gain 3 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader twice by paying 2 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire and the Vampire token, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2438-4186-6872.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
2438-4186-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4050-4375-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

4613-4968-5877.description:
Activate Vampire Scrivener by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Vampire Scrivener triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

864-3941-4067-6281.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Eternal Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Eternal Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Eternal Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat.

1479-3756-6528.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3756-6528.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Elfsworn Giant, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2292-2523-5560.notablePrerequisites: Rangers of Ithilien is your Ring-bearer.
2292-2523-5560.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Rangers of Ithilien.
When Rangers of Ithilien dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Rangers of Ithilien that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Rangers of Ithilien token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Rangers of Ithilien token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1339-2428-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2428-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God and Horizon Chimera trigger.
Resolve the Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Horizon Chimera trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

296-1806-2034-3002-5296.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Eternal Scourge is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Rest in Peace.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
The Thirteenth Doctor's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2034-2732-3490.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature token.
2034-2732-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Prowling Geistcatcher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

602-1742-4691.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
602-1742-4691.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card.
Feast of Sanity triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and causing you to gain 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat

575-2034-3510.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
575-2034-3510.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Yedora, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 Saproling due to Life and Limb.
Repeat.

632-2034-2178-4840.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Scarecrone.
Scarecrone does not have summoning sickness.
632-2034-2178-4840.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {C}{C}.
Myr Battlesphere dies, triggering Scarecrone, untapping Scarecrone.
Activate Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Myr token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1902-2816.easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Wirewood Channeler.
1902-2816.notablePrerequisites: Wirewood Channeler does not have summoning sickness. There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
1902-2816.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Wirewood Channeler by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1769-2201-2899-3025.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

976-1029-2428-3990-4435.notablePrerequisites:
Incubation Druid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Incubation Druid does not have summoning sickness.
976-1029-2428-3990-4435.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Greed by paying {B} and two life, causing you to draw two cards.
Horizon Chimera and Tolarian Kraken each trigger twice.
Resolve both Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Resolve the first Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Tolarian Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to untap Incubation Druid.
Repeat.
